propositions: Gate operations emit no progress signal between invocation start and final verdict, causing supervisor watchdogs with 600s silence budgets to kill healthy long-running calls
The 27-92s prologue and overlap-corpus phases produce no output even at DEBUG log level, comprising local compute with no instrumentation or progress logging
Model call is ~9% of total wall-clock time; silent phases are dominated by local compute (material assembly, store hydration, overlap retrieval) not model I/O
Autonomous agents executing gate operations as the final step of multi-hour runs risk state loss and stranded tickets when killed mid-close due to silence-induced stall detection
Existing test suite (test_llm_timeouts.py) explicitly encodes silence-tolerance as correct behavior and forbids total-runtime caps, constraining any remediation to be additive-only
